messages.subject: Which angle to use
parts:
Hello,

I am using your wonderful package to analyze wrist actigraph data.  I know that for my device, Xaxis is horizontal and Yaxis is vertical.  What I am not sure about is which do.angle to pick (do.anglex, do.angley, or doangle.z).  Can anyone help me with this?

Thank you!
Tarrah

messages.author: 8d92e34685fbc6bd
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Which angle to use
parts:
If do.anglex = TRUE, then the angle of the x-axis relative to the
horizontal plane is calculation.
Same for y and z.
